chapter.title: Send the power of Nirvana to the elf egg

body: As the last rays of the setting sun quietly faded, ※7⛬ and ※2⛬ concluded their day of rigorous training.
Sweat beaded on ※7⛬'s forehead, but he didn't rest, immediately setting about treating ※2⛬.
He closed his eyes slightly, concentrating, trying to guide the mysterious ※1⛬ within him.
His hands slowly approached ※2⛬, and a strange light gradually emanated from his palms, like agile threads, seeping into ※2⛬'s body.
However, today ※7⛬ only opened five of the small channels within ※2⛬, reserving the rest of his ※1⛬ to nourish the ※8⛬ eggs tonight.
He wanted to see the effect, so he saved some ※1⛬ today.
During this period, ※7⛬ had been closely observing every detail of the training process, and his miraculous system, like a loyal assistant, meticulously recorded and tallied various data.
Based on the current rate of opening eight channels within ※2⛬ daily, if all goes well, the goal should be achieved in approximately two months.
All the small channels would be opened.

But ※7⛬ knew that later on, he would not only have to allocate some ※1⛬ to nourish the ※8⛬ eggs but also new ※8⛬ that hatched would need to be cultivated; thus, completing it within three months would already be quite good.
Once achieved, according to previous estimates, ※2⛬'s aptitude would very likely be elevated to ※0⛬, so he would not have to worry about ※2⛬'s aptitude improvement for the next one or two years.
After the treatment for ※2⛬ was complete, ※7⛬ softly said to him:
"※2⛬, that's enough for today. Go rest."
※2⛬ blinked his big, round eyes; he vaguely felt that today's treatment time seemed shorter than usual, and his heart was full of doubt.
However, as soon as he thought about watching his favorite TV show, he instantly cast his doubts aside, excitedly calling out:
Then he happily ran towards the direction of the television. ※7⛬ hadn't realized that this ※6⛬ was a complete TV fanatic.
After ※7⛬ and ※6⛬ had dinner, ※2⛬ comfortably nestled on the sofa, his eyes glued to the TV screen, looking utterly content.
※7⛬ returned to his room alone, his gaze immediately drawn to the three incubators on the table.
He approached the table and unhesitatingly picked up the ※3⛬ egg, carefully placing it in front of him.
He took a deep breath, trying to calm himself down, as this was his first attempt to transmit ※1⛬ to a ※8⛬ egg, and he was inevitably a little nervous.

He was worried that if he accidentally harmed the ※8⛬ inside the egg, leading to a handicapped ※8⛬ upon hatching, it would be troublesome. Whether to continue training it or release it, neither was the outcome he wanted, so he had to proceed with caution.
※7⛬ estimated that after treating and clearing ※2⛬'s channels today, he still had about 40% of his ※1⛬ left.
He pondered for a moment, then carefully divided this 40% of ※1⛬ into four hundred equal parts.
Next, he very carefully transmitted one portion of ※1⛬ towards the ※8⛬ egg.

※7⛬ had originally thought that the ※8⛬ egg would have difficulty absorbing energy, but to his surprise, as soon as this portion of ※1⛬ was injected, it was quickly absorbed by the egg before he could even react.
After all, ※7⛬ was only a mortal, and his reaction speed couldn't compare to the system's.
Fortunately, the system detected the situation in time and informed ※7⛬:
The ※1⛬ had just been absorbed by the egg, and the egg's vitality and aptitude seemed to have improved slightly, with no adverse effects.
Seeing the system's analysis, ※7⛬ knew that there shouldn't be any major problems.
So, he plucked up his courage and transmitted nine portions of ※1⛬ to the ※8⛬ egg at once.
This time, it took a little while for the ※8⛬ egg to absorb the energy.
Through the transmitted ※1⛬, ※7⛬ saw the scene inside the egg: a softly glowing light cluster, surrounded by many channels, and a faint outline of a ※3⛬ slowly forming within the light cluster.
※7⛬ withdrew his thoughts, thinking that the light cluster and channels inside this egg seemed similar to those in ※2⛬'s body. It seemed this ※3⛬ was not far from hatching.
After the ※8⛬ egg absorbed these nine portions of ※1⛬, the system prompted that everything was normal, and its vitality and aptitude had further improved.
At this point, the system sent a message, informing ※7⛬ that ※8⛬ eggs absorb ※1⛬ more easily and improve their aptitude faster in their embryonic stage.
※7⛬ observed quietly for a while and found that the egg's condition was still good. He was completely relieved now and, without further hesitation, began slowly transmitting ※1⛬ to the ※8⛬ egg.
※7⛬'s ※1⛬ appeared to others like a vivid red glow.
He slowly transmitted it, and soon, after the ※3⛬ egg absorbed about one hundred portions of ※1⛬, it reached a saturated state.
The system prompted that this egg seemed to be "full" and could not absorb any more today, needing to rest.
※7⛬ checked and confirmed that the egg's condition was normal, then gently placed it back into the incubator.
However, the system immediately told ※7⛬ another piece of news: ※3⛬'s incubation period had suddenly changed to four days.
※7⛬ was momentarily stunned, full of confusion, not knowing why the incubation time had lengthened.
Although he was puzzled, as long as the egg was fine, he no longer dwelled on it.
Subsequently, ※7⛬ used the same method to transmit one hundred portions of ※1⛬ to the ※4⛬ egg.
The result was identical to the ※3⛬ egg: the ※4⛬ egg also reached saturation after absorbing one hundred portions of ※1⛬, and its incubation period also changed to four days.
Seeing the same changes in both, ※7⛬ gradually understood that this might not be a bad thing; on the contrary, it could be a positive change.
However, a hint of worry still lingered in his heart, so he decided to observe carefully for one night first.
If everything was calm and no abnormalities occurred tomorrow, then he planned to also transmit ※1⛬ to the ※5⛬ egg.
Although using the ※3⛬ and ※4⛬ eggs for this experiment might seem emotionally inappropriate,
※7⛬ also knew in his heart that this might be an excellent opportunity for them to change their fate and achieve a comeback.
For these two ※8⛬, how could it not be a rare and precious opportunity that is hard to come by?
After the transmission here, ※7⛬ observed for a while and found that everything was normal. ※7⛬ also breathed a sigh of relief.
Although the system had previously said that ※1⛬ could be used for nourishment, he still had no idea what the actual situation would be like.

Now that everything was normal, he felt a little relieved, but he still needed to see if there would be any problems tomorrow. If not, he would continue everything; if there were any adverse situations, he would stop immediately.
data.title: Chapter 21: Transmitting the Power of Nirvana to the Elf Egg
